mapper.select: SELECT s.schedule_id AS scheduleId, s.medication_id AS medicationId, NVL(m.item_name, '약품') AS name, TO_CHAR(s.scheduled_at, 'HH24:MI') AS time, CASE WHEN s.prescription_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'prescription' WHEN s.routine_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'supplement' WHEN s.cabinet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'regular' ELSE 'prescription' END AS type, TO_CHAR(s.taken_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS takenAt, 1 AS alarmEnabled FROM schedules s LEFT JOIN medications m ON s.medication_id = m.medication_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND TRUNC(s.scheduled_at) = TO_DATE(#{date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY s.scheduled_at ASC
SELECT medication_id AS "medicationId", item_name AS "itemName" FROM medications WHERE item_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND ROWNUM <= 15

SELECT TO_CHAR(s.scheduled_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "scheduleDate", MAX(CASE WHEN s.prescription_id IS NOT NULL OR (s.cabinet_id IS NULL AND s.routine_id IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "hasPrescription", MAX(CASE WHEN s.cabinet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "hasRegular", MAX(CASE WHEN s.routine_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "hasSupplement" FROM schedules s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND TO_CHAR(s.scheduled_at, 'YYYY-MM') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(s.scheduled_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedules ( user_id, medication_id, scheduled_at, taken_at, cabinet_id ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{medicationId}, TO_DATE(#{scheduledDate} || ' ' || #{scheduledTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), NULL, ( SELECT MIN(cabinet_id) FROM cabinet_medications WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) )
